name: return
summary: Press Return (send) in the front app

name: create
summary: Create a new command: the user asks for a new command (“create command”, “新建命令”, “写一个命令”) and describes what it should do

name: fix
summary: Fix a command that isn't working: the user names the command (“fix the volume command”, “修一下 open-website”) and says what goes wrong

name: open
summary: Open an app installed on this Mac (not a website)

name: volume
summary: Set the sound volume, or mute it

name: media-control
summary: Control music or video playback: play or pause, next or previous track

name: open-website
summary: Open a website in the browser: YouTube, Gmail, Hacker News, any site the user names
choices: any other website (named in what was said)

name: switch-app
summary: Switch to another app that's already open, by name

name: ask-muse
summary: Ask Muse, the AI assistant app, to do something: the user says “ask Muse to …”, “tell Muse …”, “让 Muse …” and what it should do
